title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1983-10-11
source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; Unknown Mics > Unknown Number Of Decks Patched Out Of > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes:TDK MA 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate V.3.0.4 To 24/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show highlighted by a scorching St. Stephen and Wang Dang Duh, captured on an audience recording that preserves the raw excitement.
ai_review.review: The performance is remembered as one of the hottest Dead shows, with nonstop energy, standout renditions of St. Stephen, Wang Dang Duh, Jack Straw, Birdsong, Bertha and a rare China Doll featuring Phil’s vocals. Reviewers note ragged vocal moments but feel the sheer power of the band outweighs any flaws, and recommend listening to a matrix or audience source to capture the vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review praises both the musical performance and overall excitement; recording quality is not detailed but implied satisfactory, leading to a high rating with low confidence due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific technical complaints; reviewer mentions ragged vocal moments but emphasizes the energy. Suggests matrix or audience listening for best experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds strong momentum with Jack Straw and Birdsong; second set erupts in high‑octane energy, especially the pre‑drums run and Bertha, culminating in a memorable St. Stephen and follow‑up 'Stones' jam.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil sang lead on China Doll with his own mic – a rare occurrence at the time.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drums run described as 'rockin' and full of energy.
